description: Set a keystore wallet as the treasury wallet for funding deployment wallets. Once set, printr_fund_deployment_wallet and printr_drain_deployment_wallet will use this wallet instead of requiring environment variables. The treasury wallet persists for the session (until the MCP server restarts). Use printr_wallet_new or printr_wallet_import to add wallets first.

wallet_id.description: Keystore wallet ID to use as treasury — from printr_wallet_list

name: printr_set_treasury_wallet
